description: Coordinate software tasks with role handoffs, review, QA, and checkpoint evidence inspection.

defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this software task using a scoped plan, implementation, review, and QA.
Resume this task from its checkpoint and verify the evidence before continuing.
Review these changes without modifying the source.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate software work across existing codebases with five focused delivery roles: architect, implementer, reviewer, QA validator and release manager. Discover project-specific manifests and check commands, load relevant skills on demand, and keep handoffs tied to current evidence. Supports framework-neutral workflows with read-only helper scripts when Node.js is available and a manual fallback otherwise. Uses the host's authorized tools; it does not grant repository access, run background agents, or provide a hosted execution service. An optional remote tool inspects checkpoint records for missing or stale review and QA fields. It does not verify that tests ran or store checkpoints.

prompts: Plan a scoped change for this codebase using its existing conventions and checks.
Investigate this bug, verify the affected behavior, and stop before release.
Review these changes without modifying the source.
Resume this checkpoint and identify any stale evidence.
Prepare these verified changes for release to the destination I specify.
